assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-03 reaching the total cap exhausts the interaction with a stable reason
assertionCoverage.clause: The total reply budget exhausts the interaction.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production BoundedGroupService is driven to its configured total cap and the persisted interaction status is asserted as exhausted.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-03 reaching the total cap exhausts the interaction with a stable reason
assertionCoverage.clause: The total-cap termination reason is stable and explicit.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production interaction record exposes the exact durable stop reason produced at the total budget boundary.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-04 a reply beyond the total cap is blocked and not recorded
assertionCoverage.clause: A reply after the total cap is refused with the same termination reason.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production service rejects the post-cap reply and the test reads the returned production error stop reason.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-04 a reply beyond the total cap is blocked and not recorded
assertionCoverage.clause: A blocked post-cap reply is not persisted.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production repository is queried after the rejected call and still contains only the two replies at the configured cap.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-05 a per-Agent budget breach ends the interaction
assertionCoverage.clause: Per-Agent budget exhaustion terminates the interaction.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production service is called past a per-Agent limit and returns the exact persisted termination reason.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-06 a distinct-Agent budget breach ends the interaction
assertionCoverage.clause: The distinct-Agent budget terminates further interaction.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production service is called with a third distinct Agent beyond the configured cap and returns the durable budget reason.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-07 Stop blocks new replies and never cancels a Run
assertionCoverage.clause: An explicit stop terminates the group interaction.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production stopInteraction path returns the persisted stopped status before the test exercises a subsequent reply.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-07 Stop blocks new replies and never cancels a Run
assertionCoverage.clause: An explicit stop records a stable user-stop reason.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production interaction record returned by stopInteraction carries the exact user-stop reason while the same test verifies the following reply is rejected.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-08 a same-Agent cycle terminates the interaction with loop-guard
assertionCoverage.clause: A same-Agent cycle is terminated by the loop guard.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production reply path detects the cycle and exposes the exact loop-guard signal.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-09 repeated content terminates the interaction with loop-guard
assertionCoverage.clause: Repeated content is terminated by the loop guard.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production reply path receives repeated content from another Agent and returns the corresponding loop-guard signal.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-10 hops beyond the configured limit terminate the interaction
assertionCoverage.clause: The configured hop budget terminates the interaction.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production service is driven beyond its configured hop limit and returns the hop-budget stop reason.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-10 hops beyond the configured limit terminate the interaction
assertionCoverage.clause: Hop overflow is classified as a loop-guard boundary.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The same production error records the exact hops-exceeded loop signal rather than allowing an unbounded walk.

assertionCoverage.name: CR5S-11 a repeated mention with no new information terminates the interaction
assertionCoverage.clause: A repeated mention with no new information is terminated.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production group reply path classifies the repeated mention as a loop-guard condition.

assertionCoverage.name: CR6-A3 the q filter never searches message bodies (secrets excluded from search)
assertionCoverage.clause: History search excludes secret content stored in Message bodies.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production history query is executed with a secret that exists only in a Message body and returns no hit.

assertionCoverage.name: CR6-A3 the q filter never searches message bodies (secrets excluded from search)
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The same production query path still returns an ordinary task label, showing that secret exclusion is field-scoped rather than a blanket search failure.
